name: Tenex Seal-Coat Slip-On
description: A flat canvas slip-on shoe with a sole so thin it's nearly gone at the ball of the foot. The entire exterior has been painted over with Tenex industrial sealant — a grey-brown rubberized coating applied by brush, lumpy in places, cracked at the toe flexion point. It's ugly and it works. Keeps water out most of the time.
functionality: Improvised waterproofing. Sealant reduces breathability significantly.
what_it_says: You know how to make things last. You also haven't had a dry day in weeks.
worn_by: people working near water or drainage runoff
manufacturer: Unknown canvas base, Tenex sealant (Korova Industrial)
story_hooks: Tenex sealant leaves a distinctive chemical signature. Forensics can track anyone who walked through a sealed area.
An old woman's been recoating the same shoes every six months for eleven years. She knows every corner of the Shelf by what got them wet.

physical_description.visual_profile: A brutally utilitarian slip-on with a slouched, broken-in silhouette. The shoe reads as deliberately unglamorous—a canvas base transformed into armored footwear through crude industrial application. The Tenex coating gives it an organic, weathered appearance, like concrete that's been exposed to years of moisture and foot traffic.
physical_description.fit: Loose, relaxed slip-on fit with minimal structure. The thin sole allows natural foot flex, creating a worn, molded appearance at the toe and heel.
physical_description.primary_material: Canvas base with heavy Tenex industrial sealant coating (rubberized polymer composite). The sealant obscures original fabric beneath.
physical_description.texture: Lumpy, brush-applied coating with visible directional sweep marks. Cracked and spider-webbed at the toe flexion point where the shoe bends. Surface is semi-gloss, matte in cracks. Rough to the touch, uneven thickness.
physical_description.color_scheme: Muddy grey-brown base with darker stress-crack lines forming at flex points. Occasional lighter streaks where sealant pooled. Monochromatic, industrial aesthetic.
distinctive_features: Crude brush-applied Tenex sealant creating intentionally imperfect coverage
Visible cracks at ball-of-foot and toe bend points
Threadbare sole with visible wear-through at ball of foot
No visible branding or finishing touches
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4-5 functional/salvage footwear. Cheap base material elevated by industrial utility.
physical_description.cultural_context: Street survivor, maintenance worker, or ungoverned zone inhabitant. Someone who values water-sealing over aesthetics. Practical modification culture—making do with what's available.
physical_description.condition_typical: Perpetually weathered and broken-in. Expected to show cracks and flaking sealant with regular wear. Condition worsens gradually but remains functional.
